# Limitations {#sec-limitations}

Every "this cannot show" statement in the book, gathered in one place. Each links back to the section that measured it.

## From the design {#sec-limitations-design}

::: {.content-hidden when-profile="gallery"}
- With four samples per group, the synthetic example design cannot separate a treatment effect from a difference between individual samples (@sec-design-samples).
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="gallery"}
- The gallery's synthetic design has four samples per group. It cannot separate a group effect from a sample effect (@sec-g-anatomy).
:::

## From the detection floor {#sec-limitations-floor}

::: {.content-hidden when-profile="gallery"}
- Changes smaller than the per-feature floor cannot be seen. A feature that did not pass may still have changed (@sec-detection-floor-mde).
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="gallery"}
- The gallery shows figures, not a floor. No gallery figure can show that a change is absent (@sec-g-figures).
:::

## From the material {#sec-limitations-material}

::: {.content-hidden when-profile="gallery"}
- Replace with what the samples themselves cannot show, for example a mixture of cell types (@sec-quality-depth).
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="gallery"}
- The data are simulated. They cannot show anything about a real sample (@sec-g-tables).
:::

## From the annotation {#sec-limitations-annotation}

::: {.content-hidden when-profile="gallery"}
- Replace with what the feature annotation cannot show, for example features with no known function (@sec-results-volcano).
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="gallery"}
- The feature names are generated. They carry no annotation at all (@sec-g-provenance).
:::

## Not yet implemented {#sec-limitations-not-implemented}

| Missing item | Chapter it belongs in |
|---|---|
| Permutation calibration of the FDR | Robustness |
| An equivalence test for features that did not pass | Results |
